title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
abstract: arXiv:2610.13783v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

translated_title: UkrMeme：乌克兰梗图中的多模态可解释说服检测
translated_abstract: 梗图在现代网络交流中扮演着核心角色，尤其是在政治冲突的背景下，视觉与文本线索相结合以传递具有说服力的信息。我们使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）研究乌克兰梗图中的说服技术检测。我们介绍了UkrMeme——一个包含200张自然产生的乌克兰战时梗图并针对说服技术进行标注的数据集，以及PTM-UA——Propaganda 950基准的一个子集的乌克兰语翻译版本，该版本在翻译梗图文本的同时保留了原始视觉内容。我们在零样本提示设置下，使用分层F1指标，评估了视觉-语言模型在图像、文本和多模态输入上的表现。最后，我们比较了逐层相关性传播（LRP）与模型生成的词元归因，并分析了各种解释方法所强调证据的语义类别。
tldr: 本文发布了包含200张乌克兰战时梗图的说服技术检测数据集UkrMeme及乌克兰语翻译基准PTM-UA，并评估了视觉-语言模型在零样本多模态设置下的说服检测性能及可解释性方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, along with PTM-UA, a Ukrainian-translated benchmark, and evaluates vision-language models in zero-shot multimodal persuasion detection with explainability analysis.
